common.metaDescription: DRPS Batch-19 Foundation — secure, transparent donations verified by our team.

landing.heroStatsNote: Approved donations only. Updated every minute.
landing.causesLead: Every donation goes to one of four funds. Pick the one that matters to you.
landing.causeGeneralDesc: Directed wherever the need is greatest right now.
landing.causeEducationDesc: Books, tuition and scholarships for students.
landing.causeEmergencyDesc: Fast response to floods, fires and crises.
landing.step1Body: Sign in with Google, pick an amount and the fund you want to support.
landing.step2Body: Use bKash Send Money to our number and note the transaction ID (TrxID).
landing.step3Body: Enter the TrxID. An admin matches it in bKash and confirms your donation.
landing.peopleLead: Alumni who run the foundation and answer for every taka.
landing.eventsLead: Meetings, drives and fundraisers. Come along.
landing.storyQuote: We started this foundation so that no classmate, teacher or neighbour has to face a hard month alone.
landing.storyBody: Help reaches people as school fees paid on time, medicine bought the same day, and relief packed within hours of a flood. Your donation becomes part of that work.
landing.faqLead: Answers to what people ask us most.
landing.faq1A: Bangladesh has no government tax deduction for charitable giving. We keep a record of every transaction and can share it on request.
landing.faq2A: Yes. We encourage public donations because they build trust, but the choice is yours.
landing.faq3Q: Can I choose which cause I support?
landing.faq3A: Yes. On the donate page you pick one of four funds: general, education, medical or emergency.
landing.faq4Q: How long does TrxID verification take?
landing.faq4A: Usually a few hours, and up to 24 hours on holidays. You can follow the status in your donation history.
landing.trustLead: We handle money the way we would want ours handled.
landing.trust1Body: An admin matches each transaction in the bKash app before a donation counts.
landing.trust2Body: Totals by fund and month are tracked and shared with members.
landing.trust3Body: Your dashboard shows every donation you made and its status.
landing.ctaTitle: Give what you can. We'll take it the rest of the way.
landing.introBody: We are former students of DRPS. Together we turn small, regular gifts into school fees, medicine and emergency relief for classmates, teachers and neighbours.
landing.impactLead: A few examples of what a single donation pays for.
landing.impact1: Books and stationery for one student for a term
landing.impact2: A month of medicine for a family in need
landing.impact3: Food and relief packs for a family after a flood
landing.impactNote: Examples to show scale. Every gift goes to the fund you choose.
landing.involvedLead: Money matters, but so do time, presence and a good word.
landing.involved1Body: Give to the fund that matters most to you.
landing.involved2Body: Join a drive, a meeting or a fundraiser.
landing.involved3Body: Reconnect with batchmates and help run the foundation.
landing.involved4Body: Share this page with friends and family.
landing.people1Desc: Leads the committee and sets the foundation's priorities.
landing.people2Desc: Keeps the books and checks every TrxID against bKash.
landing.people3Desc: Organises drives and events and keeps members in the loop.
landing.peopleJoinBody: Every batchmate is welcome to join the committee and volunteer.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: An alumni-run foundation that helps our community when it matters most.
about.body1: The DRPS Batch-19 Foundation was set up by former students to support classmates, teachers and neighbours through education costs, medical bills and emergencies.
about.body2: Donations arrive through bKash. Each one is matched against its transaction ID by an admin before it is counted, so every taka on this site is real money that reached us.
about.pillar1Body: Books, tuition and scholarships so students stay in school.
about.pillar2Body: Help with surgery, medicine and urgent care.
about.pillar3Body: Fast response when floods, fires or crises hit.
about.ctaBody: Sign in with Google and donate in about three minutes.

blog.title: Stories from the field

submit.title: Send money with bKash

submit.step1: Open bKash and choose Send Money.
submit.step3: Write the reference in the bKash reference field.
submit.step4: Enter the TrxID from bKash and the number you sent from.
submit.trxHelp: Find it in your bKash app under Transaction history.
submit.phoneHelp: The number you sent the money from.
submit.reviewNote: We only use your bKash number to match the transaction.
